name: MerlonDocs
description: Merlon Docs en-US prose cues: numbered heading mentions (Chapter/Section/Ch./Sec.) without a GFM markdown link, claims pinned to a date with 'as of' or 'until' before an ISO date, and code-shaped names (calls, snake_case, UPPER_SNAKE) outside backticks. Prefer links to target shards; Merlon Docs validates link targets separately.
